title: China's EV Boom Just Passed The Rest Of The World
source: International Energy Agency, Global EV Outlook reports (2020-2025), plus industry tallies (Canalys, CleanTechnica). Approximate annual battery-electric + plug-in-hybrid sales; China's share of global EV sales grew from roughly 40% in 2020 to about 60% in 2024, putting its own annual sales ahead of every other country combined since around 2022.
